summary: Project isolation of the library and knowledge base at view level, as project tabs: a panel at the top of the left directory with 全部项目 and one tab per project (the current project first, with counts), the category tree inside. A project tab shows only that project's papers (rows carry project tags), folds categories that hold only other projects' papers behind a note, marks categories shared by projects 跨项目 with per-project counts; the knowledge graph has focus modes (全貌 / 当前类别 / 论文·1 跳 / 论文·2 跳) that remove the other nodes and an overview guard for more than 60 papers; the snapshot carries which projects saved each paper; switching project resets the view. A partial view never overrides or saves the shared layout, 重新排列 touches only drawn nodes. No migration, no schema change.
scope_note: Branch feature/route-mode on top of 1e8dcb1. organization.py snapshot (additive fields) and organization.js; stage 3 of 4.
